title.narrative: Delegation Agreement between the EU and the EIF in respect of the Administration of a Participation in the Green for Growth Fund (GGF) and Administration of a Participation in the Technical Assistance Facility related to GGF

description.narrative: This Action aims at securing continuation of the EU investments in the financial instrument Green for Growth Fund (GGF), as well as to ensure continued delivery of technical assistance to the GGF beneficiary intermediaries. The overall objective is to foster economic development and prosperity in South East Europe through the provision of development financing for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects.
